qa_pair.question: Among the organization's archived (inactive) MCP profiles, which one has the largest token budget? Answer with the profile name only.
How many tasks bound to the "Sales Copilot" profile are still in the scheduled status? Answer with a number.
Of all tasks whose status is scheduled, which one is set to run first? Answer with the task title only.
What is the combined token budget of all active MCP profiles? Answer with a number without separators.
Which MCP profile is the currently escalated task bound to? Answer with the profile name only.
How many tasks, in any status, are bound to profiles that are archived? Answer with a number.
Which API key has a tool whitelist that allows scheduling new tasks? Answer with the key name only.
Which MCP profile has the most tasks bound to it, counting every status? Answer with the profile name only.
How many of the organization's API keys expire before January 1, 2027? Answer with a number.
Considering every MCP profile, active or archived, that has no tasks bound to it, which has the smallest token budget? Answer with the profile name only.
